tools.name: product_lookup
tools.description: Look up one product by its barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A, check digit validated). Returns factual data from ProductGuru: name, brand/maker, manufacturer website (when known), category, recorded attributes, and official recall notices (agency, date, notice link), plus the URL of the ProductGuru product page. Official recall notices linked to the barcode (agency, date, hazard, official notice link) are returned even when ProductGuru has no published product page for it; the product fields then stay empty (found=false). One barcode per call; no search or listing.

ean.description: One barcode: EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A digits (string or number).
ean.title: Ean

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ProductGuru's published products and official recall notices. Pass a barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A) to get that product and any recall notice linked to it, or words (e.g. 'power bank') to search product names. Returns at most 10 results, each with an id, title and URL; pass an id to fetch for the full factual record. Ids are 'p:<ean>' (product) or 'r:<recall>' (recall notice). Medicines are not covered.

query.description: A barcode (8, 12 or 13 digits) or a few words naming a product.
query.title: Query

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one ProductGuru record by the id that search returned: 'p:<ean>' for a product (name, brand/maker, category, recorded attributes, linked recall notices) or 'r:<recall>' for an official recall notice (issuing agency, date, summary, link to the authority's notice). Returns id, title, text, url and metadata. Factual data only.

tools.name: repair_nearby
tools.description: Find repair businesses near a location in France, Czechia, Slovakia, Austria or Germany (OpenStreetMap + ADEME data). Give either a barcode (ean, the product's repair category is looked up) or a repair_type, plus either lat+lon (rounded to ~1 km before use, never stored) or postcode+country. Returns up to 10 repairers with distance, address, website, opening hours and the source/licence line for each. repair_type is one of: phone_tablet, computer, tv_audio, appliance_large, appliance_small, electronics, photo, tools_garden, bike, e_mobility, shoes_leather, clothing, furniture, watch_jewellery, lighting, toys, sport, music, general.

repair_type.description: Repair category, e.g. phone_tablet, bike, appliance_large.
repair_type.title: Repair Type

postcode.description: Postcode, used with country instead of lat/lon.
postcode.title: Postcode

country.description: FR, CZ, SK, AT or DE (with postcode).
country.title: Country
